Name: Jeroham of Gedor
Summary: Father of Joelah and Zebadiah who came to David at Ziklag.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:7: Father of Joelah and Zebadiah who came to David at Ziklag.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeroham in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
